text.p: Colombian stocks ended virtually unchanged in busy trading dominated by foreign fund demand for banking and brewing.
Medellin's IBOMED general price index edged down a wafer-thin 0.06 percent to 18,393.73 pesos. Bogota's IBB price index finished ahead 0.08 percent to 1,206.96 on volume of 7 billion pesos.

Dealers said foreign funds dominated Bogota trading with demands for brewing giant Bavaria and Banco Industrial Colombiano. In Medellin, investors were restructuring portfolios, selling off fixed income paper in favor of stocks.
Banco Industrial led the gainers, finishing up 1.26 percent to a year high of 4,000 on 2.25 billion pesos traded in Bogota, and was up 0.50 percent to 3,970 on volume of 47 million in Medellin.
Bavaria finished up one peso to 8,151 in Bogota but slipped 0.58 percent to 8,152 in Medellin.
Insurance giant Compania Suramericana de Seguros held steady at 28,000 in Bogota, but fell 0.35 percent to 28,000 in Medellin.
